correctness.rationale: For the general complex rank-16 N-polarized K3 in Clingher–Hill–Malmendier, fiberwise translation by the alternate elliptic pencil’s nonzero 2-torsion section swaps a1 with b4 and preserves individually the two I2 fiber component pairs. Independently reconstructing the full weighted 19-vertex graph gives four automorphisms; exactly one satisfies those constraints, with nine stated transpositions and a7 fixed setwise. The 19x19 curve intersection Gram has rank 16. The 9x9 difference Gram has rank 8, primitive null vector (4,6,8,6,4,2,4,1,1), and determinant 1024 on a natural 8-element difference basis. Anti-invariant lattice E8(-2) has determinant 256 by the standard symplectic Nikulin theorem; hence the finite index is sqrt(1024/256)=2. The calculations and identification of the geometric action use actual source graph and fiber hypotheses, not a bare VERIFY_OK.
